sourceSchema.head: 0045_provider_attestation_nonce_replay_guard.sql
sourceSchema.reason: Expected version is a stable snapshot token over the existing backup record; restore idempotency uses the existing unique (backup_run_id, request_id) index. No production or local schema migration was applied.

databaseObjects.transaction: Lock backup_runs row FOR UPDATE; recheck eligibility and expected snapshot; insert one PLANNED restore_runs row, append audit, enqueue outbox in the same transaction. Matching idempotency replay returns existing row without paired writes; changed fingerprint denies.

authorization.drillPermission: PERM-BKP-RESTORE-DRILL with GLOBAL scope; checked server-side in RequestRestoreUseCase
authorization.productionPermission: PERM-BKP-RESTORE-PRODUCTION remains denied by unresolved RD-020 policy, even if the grant is supplied
authorization.ui: Only shows request entry when the explicit restore grant is active and has GLOBAL scope; UI is not the security boundary.

authoritySources.contract: Restore drill is an explicit permission (Admin matrix ALLOW); production restore remains DENY UNTIL APPROVED (RD-020).
PERM-BKP-RESTORE-DRILL and PERM-BKP-RESTORE-PRODUCTION apply to REQUEST_RESTORE on BACKUP_RESTORE only in CREATED/VERIFIED state.
Production restore policy is false/default-deny; drill cannot target production; eligible states come from the existing backup-record domain rule.
Production restore authority/signature remains unresolved and deny-by-default.

idempotency.keySource: One UUID key rendered in the request form and reused by native POST and JavaScript enhancement
idempotency.semantics: Same backup/key/fingerprint is one intent; changed reason/target/type/version with the same key is CONFLICT_DUPLICATE_COMMAND. Separate form intents have separate keys.

securityBoundary: Restore request records PLANNED only; no provider executor, file overwrite, database overwrite, or restore-completion claim is reachable from GET or POST.
